subject: RECORD DELIMITER clause
notes: "The implementor shall specify the names available for use as feature-name-1" is DISCHARGED, and discharged in the negative: the set specified is EMPTY, filed as docs/CONFORMANCE.md §7 Annex A.1 item 150. That is a specification and not an omission — A.1's preamble classes item 150 as optional and defines the class as "Optional: The element may be provided at the implementor's option" (cite.py --check A.1 OK). The compiler agrees with the register: every spelling written in the feature-name-1 position draws COBOL1778 naming the clause as unsupported, so no word is silently accepted as a delimiter selector and §12.4.5.11.4 GR4 never has a method to look up. The DOC row for the same obligation is DOC-A.1-150, whose verdict differs by design — that row asks whether the OPTIONAL ELEMENT is provided (it is not), this row asks whether the implementor answered the question (it did).
